evidence.claim: MSA Damper progetta e produce ad Asti ammortizzatori su misura per reti ferroviarie e applicazioni automotive pesanti, lavorando con OEM globali e ferrovie nazionali.
evidence.quote: We design and manufacture tailor-made shock absorbers engineered to withstand the world’s most demanding railway networks and heavy-duty automotive applications. || From our headquarters and manufacturing facility in Asti, Italy , we combine world-class Italian engineering with rigorous industrial standards || our engineering team works closely with global OEMs, fleet managers, and National Railways to develop custom shock absorbers
